notes: Mid-market -> enterprise FinTech. Short version: Pitched Redwood Dedicated + Private combo for low-latency reranking and on-prem KV caching. Initial interest strong; exec sponsor (Head of ML Ops, Jonah Reyes) advocated private deployment. Over Q3 procurement and security escalations slowed. Competitive win: Together offered a packaged on-prem appliance + deep audit/HSM claim and a 6-month pilot price below our estimate; legal accepted their attestation faster. Key quotes: "We need an appliance we can ship into our colo and the vendor has to drop ship HSM-integrated images" — Jonah. Security team raised FIPS/HSM requirement late (oct) and asked for vendor-signed HSM attestation; our private on-prem path requires SOC/T&Cs updates and would take 10+ weeks. Also internal budget freeze hit hiring; no champion remained after Jonah moved to a new role. Team moved forward with Together in late Oct. Action items: capture technical gaps (HSM attestation, packaged appliance), update sales playbook, notify solutions engineering to create a rapid HSM/airgap FAQ. Follow-up note to be sent to CISO for future re-engage.

use_case_summary: Primary workloads: latency-sensitive reranking for signals (p95 target 30-50ms), high-throughput embeddings for semantic search (bulk ingestion 30M docs), trader-facing chat assistant (low latency, audit logging). Needs: on-prem/VPC deployment, HSM-backed key management, SOC2+ISO attestation, strict data residency, and predictable throughput for peak windows.
loss_reason_summary: Lost to Together. Main reasons: vendor offered a pre-packaged on-prem appliance with HSM integration and faster attestation process; lower pilot pricing; Redwood private deployment required contract/security changes and estimated >10 week runway to meet HSM attestation; internal sponsor left and budget freeze removed urgency.
